Sandbox_HARMONIE_DecayPerDay_tooltip: Reserve points lost per in-game day once a vitamin's banked pause days run out (see the mod's Reserve/Decay/Pause mechanic).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_ReserveGainDivisor_tool: Reserve gained = (percent of daily requirement eaten) / this number. Higher = slower gain from food.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CriticalThreshold_toolt: Reserve value below which a vitamin is considered Critical and starts causing its deficiency effect.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SufficientThreshold_too: Reserve value a vitamin must climb back up to before a Critical affliction's effect stops (not just leaving Critical).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_EnableCriticalEffects_t: Turn off to track vitamin Reserves without any gameplay penalty for deficiency.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SymptomReminderHours_to: How often, in game hours, a character with at least one Critical vitamin re-rolls their in-character symptom comment. Lower = comments more often (e.g. 6 = up to 4 times a day).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminD_tooltip: Standing outside in daylight (9:00 to 16:59, no rain) slowly gives vitamin D Reserve, like skin in the sun. Winter months give half.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminDPerHour_tool: Vitamin D Reserve gained per game hour outside in daylight.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminDMaxPerDay_to: The most vitamin D Reserve sunlight can give in one game day. The default 3 is under the daily decay, so food is still needed.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookMinigames_tooltip: Preparing an ingredient in the Cooking tab is a short minigame. Off: preparing still works but scores 0.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookXPMultiplier_toolti: Cooking XP from preparing ingredients in the Cooking tab, times this.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffs: Cooking tab: buffs from well prepared dishes
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffs_tooltip: A dish's score (the average of its prepared ingredients, weighed by how much of each went in) gives buff level 1 / 2 / 3 when eaten -- see the score and level settings below.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffHours_tooltip: How long dish buffs last, times this.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookMinigameTime_toolti: How long each cooking minigame lasts before it times out, times this (2.0 = twice the base time). A higher Cooking level adds more on top.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_FoodVitaminMultiplier_t: Every vitamin gained by eating is multiplied by this. 1 = the food's real amount, 5 = five times as much (default). Sunlight and vitamin pills are not affected.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookDebugLog_tooltip: Write one console line for every ingredient prepared and every scored dish addition or craft. Off: one summary line per game hour (refused requests are always logged).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookScoreExcellent_tool: Score an ingredient gets when its minigame ends Excellent (default 2). Counts for food prepared before a change too.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookScoreGood_tooltip: Score an ingredient gets when its minigame ends Good (default 1). Counts for food prepared before a change too.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookScoreBad_tooltip: Score an ingredient gets when its minigame ends Poor (default -0.5). Counts for food prepared before a change too.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookScoreMiss_tooltip: Score an ingredient gets when its minigame ends Missed (default -1). Counts for food prepared before a change too.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier1: Cooking tab: dish score for buff level 1
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier1_tooltip: A dish scoring at least this gives buff level 1 when eaten (default 0.5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier2: Cooking tab: dish score for buff level 2
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier2_tooltip: A dish scoring at least this gives buff level 2 when eaten (default 1.0).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier3: Cooking tab: dish score for buff level 3
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier3_tooltip: A dish scoring at least this gives buff level 3 when eaten (default 1.5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier3Level: Cooking tab: Cooking level for buff level 3
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffTier3Level_tool: Buff level 3 only when the cook had at least this Cooking level; below it the dish gives level 2 (default 5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffStrength1_toolt: How strong buff level 1 is, times the base effect (default 1.0).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffStrength2_toolt: How strong buff level 2 is, times the base effect (default 1.5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffStrength3_toolt: How strong buff level 3 is, times the base effect (default 2.0).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffLength1_tooltip: How long buff level 1 lasts, times (2 + the cook's Cooking level) game hours (default 0.5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffLength2_tooltip: How long buff level 2 lasts, times (2 + the cook's Cooking level) game hours (default 1.0).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffLength3_tooltip: How long buff level 3 lasts, times (2 + the cook's Cooking level) game hours (default 1.5).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBadDishUnhappy: Cooking tab: unhappiness from a badly prepared dish
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBadDishUnhappy_tool: A dish scoring below 0 adds this much unhappiness when all of it is eaten (default 10).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookVarietyBonus_toolti: A dish with 3 kinds of food (vegetable, meat, herb, fruit...) gets this added to its score, 4 or more kinds twice this (default 0.25). Not for a dish whose own average is below 0.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookChefXP: Cooking tab: cook's XP when others eat
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookChefXP_tooltip: When another player eats a dish that gives a buff, its cook gets this much Cooking XP per buff level, times the share eaten (default 5).
